title: Dialogue policy reads an intent and keeps an honest miss
summary: The dialogue layer reads one intent for the heard line, including ask, recall, correct, forget, and goodbye. Recall needs one person-memory source. Otherwise the reply is the honest miss.
body:
The dialogue module decides the next move after retrieval has already produced a clause or an honest miss. The heard line is read once as an intent. Labels kept from the earlier layer are chat, ask, task, vent, and goodbye. A fixed English phrase table then refines the line to recall, correct, or forget. Precedence is correction, then forget, then recall. A forget phrase sitting against a negation does not count as forget. An unknown label is chat.

Recall speaks a person-memory source, prefixed memory or learned and carrying an id, or the honest miss when the gathered sources are not one. A correction or a forget becomes that same miss and does not repeat the last sourced clause. Check-ins stay off until the person turns them on. A callback is stored only when remember is granted. The heuristic is the policy. An offline counter does not change the move, and a correction or a forget is not counted. Nothing in this layer writes a file or reads the diary.
